recognize_zh: 周邊血嗜酸性球增多並伴隨核略不規則的非典型淋巴球，流式可見一群表面抗原異常的 T 細胞（框選處）；淋巴結副皮質區擴張、混有許多嗜酸性球，CD2 陽性但 CD7 大量流失，形似周邊 T 細胞淋巴瘤，實為淋巴球變異型嗜酸性球增多症候群。
features: Panel A (PB): increased mature eosinophils with bilobed nuclei and orange granules
Panel A (PB): small-to-medium lymphocytes with mildly irregular/indented nuclei and moderate pale cytoplasm
Panel B: flow cytometry plots with a gated aberrant T-cell population (red) separated from normal T cells (axis labels not legible)
Panel C (LN low power): preserved follicles with markedly expanded paracortex
Panel D (LN high power): polymorphous paracortical infiltrate of small-to-medium lymphocytes with numerous eosinophils and high endothelial venules
Panel E: CD2 diffusely positive in the paracortex; CD7 positive in only scattered cells (loss of CD7)
describe_en: Peripheral blood smear shows eosinophilia accompanied by atypical small-to-medium lymphocytes with irregular nuclei, and flow cytometry identifies a distinct aberrant T-cell population. The lymph node shows preserved follicles with marked paracortical expansion by a polymorphous infiltrate rich in eosinophils; immunostains show diffuse CD2 expression with loss of CD7 in most paracortical T cells. In context, findings are consistent with the lymphocytic variant of hypereosinophilic syndrome driven by an aberrant cytokine-producing T-cell clone (typically CD3−CD4+ or CD7−), which can mimic peripheral T-cell lymphoma and requires clinical correlation and follow-up.

ddx.vs: PTCL effaces nodal architecture with sheets of cytologically atypical T cells and broader antigen loss, whereas L-HES preserves follicles with a mild aberrant population and indolent course.
AITL shows expanded FDC meshworks, arborizing HEVs and TFH markers (PD1, CXCL13, ICOS) with EBV+ B blasts.

ddx.dx: Myeloid/lymphoid neoplasm with eosinophilia and tyrosine kinase fusion
ddx.vs: These carry PDGFRA/PDGFRB/FGFR1/JAK2 rearrangements with myeloid marrow abnormalities and lack a cytokine-producing aberrant T-cell clone.
Reactive hyperplasia has an immunophenotypically normal T-cell population without CD7 loss or a clonal aberrant subset.

stain: Wright-Giemsa; H&E; IHC: CD2, CD7; flow cytometry
